name: Crisp stream fish
summary: Cá suối rán giòn is crisp-fried stream fish on the national Sa Pa list. The fish and the batter were not described. Anh Dũng also names cá suối.
origin: The national Sa Pa food paragraph, with bánh ngô, bánh đao, and bánh dầy.
howToEat: In Sa Pa, it comes fried until crisp.
In Mai Châu, cá suối covers small fish such as cá bống and cá quả, fried or grilled and eaten bones and all. It is not on the table every day, and cá suối chiên is its own plate.
where: In Sa Pa, Anh Dũng at 06 Xuân Viên lists cá suối.
In Mai Châu, the Pom Coọng homestays, where guests also eat grilled fish with the meal.
seoTitle: Crisp stream fish in Sapa — named, not priced
seoDescription: Cá suối rán giòn in Sa Pa.
